patch_description: The best prior generation (0.72) used exact-analytic gradients of a soft-min (LogSumExp) objective over all 286 triangle areas with Adam and unit-hull rescaling — a massive speedup over finite-difference or random hill climbing, since each step costs O(286) vectorized work. The current program regressed to naive random hill climbing (0.71). This edit reinstates the analytic-gradient Adam core, diversifies the seed portfolio per the recommendation (reversed-chirality spiral, 9+4 two-cluster arcs, perturbed 13-gon), and replaces the single-incumbent polish loop with an alternating top-2 basin re-anneal schedule (short Adam runs, lr=0.005, p0=200), which the evidence shows drove the 0.67→0.72 gains. A final bottleneck-targeted polish extracts exact local optimality. Determinism is preserved via fixed seeds.
